defaults.title: SSH brute force
defaults.content: Many failed password or invalid user events in a short time window.
defaults.advice: Limit source IP, enable MFA, and audit weak credentials.
defaults.advice_cn: 限制高风险来源 IP，启用 MFA，并审计弱口令账号与暴力破解来源。

defaults.title: Unauthorized access attempt
defaults.content: Frequent permission denied, unauthorized, or forbidden events across protected resources.
defaults.advice: Review access policy boundaries and account permissions.
defaults.advice_cn: 核查访问边界、防护规则与账号权限配置，确认是否存在越权访问。

defaults.title: SQL injection pattern
defaults.content: Request parameters include union select, or 1=1, sleep and similar SQL injection payloads.
defaults.advice: Enable WAF and parameterized queries, audit DB error logs.
defaults.advice_cn: 启用 WAF 与参数化查询，并结合数据库错误日志核查是否存在注入探测或利用。

defaults.title: XSS injection pattern
defaults.content: Request contains script tag or onerror/onload style script injection patterns.
defaults.advice: Apply output encoding and CSP, strengthen input validation.
defaults.advice_cn: 实施输出编码与 CSP 策略，并加强输入校验，排查受影响页面模板。

defaults.title: Privilege escalation activity
defaults.content: Frequent sudo, su, or root transitions with sensitive command execution.
defaults.advice: Apply least privilege and audit sudoers and command chains.
defaults.advice_cn: 落实最小权限原则，审计 sudoers、特权组成员与高危命令链。

defaults.title: HDFS block transfer interruption
defaults.content: Connection reset by peer or broken pipe during block transfer.
defaults.advice: Check network stability and DataNode link health.
defaults.advice_cn: 检查网络稳定性与 DataNode 链路健康状态。

defaults.title: HDFS replication timeout
defaults.content: PendingReplicationMonitor timed out blocks and replication lag increased.
defaults.advice: Inspect replication queue and cluster load balance.
defaults.advice_cn: 检查副本队列、复制压力与集群负载均衡情况。

defaults.title: DataNode IO stream exception
defaults.content: IOException while receiving or writing HDFS blocks.
defaults.advice: Audit disk IO pressure and verify storage hardware state.
defaults.advice_cn: 审计磁盘 IO 压力与文件系统状态，检查存储硬件健康。

defaults.title: NameNode metadata inconsistency
defaults.content: Block map update anomalies or redundant addStoredBlock requests.
defaults.advice: Verify NameNode metadata consistency and replay state.
defaults.advice_cn: 核查 NameNode 元数据一致性与恢复状态，确认是否存在块状态漂移。

defaults.title: Suspicious SSH successful login
defaults.content: Accepted password or publickey login from a new host, unusual source IP, or suspicious account context.
defaults.advice: Verify login user, source IP, login time, and post-login command activity; disable or lock the account if unauthorized.
defaults.advice_cn: 核对登录用户、来源 IP、登录时段与后续命令活动，如非授权应立即锁定账号并阻断来源。

defaults.title: Suspicious SSH session establishment
defaults.content: pam_unix(sshd:session) session opened events after risky authentication activity.
defaults.advice: Correlate with preceding authentication logs and audit commands executed in the session; review lateral movement traces.
defaults.advice_cn: 结合前序认证日志与会话内命令进行关联分析，重点核查是否存在横向移动痕迹。

defaults.title: Privileged audit command execution
defaults.content: Linux audit EXECVE or related privileged events involving sudo, uid=0, or sensitive command chains.
defaults.advice: Review audit trail, sudo chain, privileged binaries, and sensitive file changes; tighten sudoers and privileged group membership.
defaults.advice_cn: 重点审查 audit 轨迹、sudo 链路、特权二进制与敏感文件变更，并收紧 sudoers 与特权组权限。

defaults.title: Restricted web resource probing
defaults.content: Apache errors such as AH01630 or denied-by-configuration indicating probing of restricted paths.
defaults.advice: Inspect requested paths, tighten Apache or WAF rules, and rate-limit or block probing clients.
defaults.advice_cn: 检查被请求资源路径，收紧 Apache/WAF 规则，并对探测客户端实施限速或封禁。

defaults.title: Web scanner fingerprint activity
defaults.content: WPScan, Nmap NSE, or similar scanner fingerprints in access logs targeting admin paths or plugins.
defaults.advice: Block or rate-limit scanner IPs, review exposed admin paths and plugins, and correlate with WAF or reverse proxy logs.
defaults.advice_cn: 封禁或限速扫描源 IP，检查暴露的管理路径与插件，并结合 WAF 或反向代理日志核对影响范围。

defaults.title: Content negotiation probing
defaults.content: Apache negotiation errors such as AH00687 that may indicate path discovery or malformed request probing.
defaults.advice: Review suspicious request paths and file extensions, verify Apache content negotiation settings, and investigate repeated probing from the same client.
defaults.advice_cn: 核查可疑请求路径与扩展名，检查 Apache 协商配置，并追踪同一客户端的重复探测行为。

defaults.title: SSH excessive login attempts
defaults.content: Maximum login attempts exceeded or repeated authentication failures for privileged accounts.
defaults.advice: Block the offending source, inspect targeted accounts, and enable account lockout or MFA for exposed identities.
defaults.advice_cn: 封禁异常来源，检查被针对账号，并为暴露身份启用登录失败锁定或 MFA。

defaults.title: SSH root login success
defaults.content: Accepted password or publickey login for root or another privileged account from an unusual source.
defaults.advice: Immediately verify the legitimacy of the privileged login, rotate exposed credentials, and review commands executed after login.
defaults.advice_cn: 立即核查特权账号登录合法性，轮换可疑凭据，并审计登录后的命令执行与会话行为。

defaults.title: SSH publickey login from unusual source
defaults.content: Accepted publickey authentication from a new host, unusual subnet, or unexpected service account context.
defaults.advice: Check authorized_keys, source subnet, and account history; revoke suspicious keys and review lateral movement traces.
defaults.advice_cn: 检查 authorized_keys、来源网段与账号历史行为，吊销可疑密钥并核查横向移动痕迹。

defaults.title: SSH disconnect churn after authentication
defaults.content: Frequent disconnect, reset, or short-lived SSH sessions after authentication attempts, suggesting enumeration or unstable brute force tooling.
defaults.advice: Correlate disconnects with nearby failed and successful logins, inspect tooling fingerprints, and throttle the source host.
defaults.advice_cn: 将异常断连与相邻认证失败、成功登录事件关联分析，识别工具指纹，并对来源主机实施限速。

defaults.title: Web admin path enumeration
defaults.content: Repeated access to /admin, /login, /wp-login.php, or management endpoints with probing behavior.
defaults.advice: Review exposed admin endpoints, tighten authentication and access controls, and block aggressive probing clients.
defaults.advice_cn: 检查暴露的管理入口，强化认证与访问控制，并封禁高频探测客户端。

defaults.title: Web login brute-force pattern
defaults.content: Repeated login attempts against application login endpoints with changing usernames, parameters, or source cadence.
defaults.advice: Enable login throttling, MFA, and account lockout; review targeted users and originating IP reputation.
defaults.advice_cn: 启用登录限速、MFA 与账号锁定策略，并检查被针对用户与来源 IP 信誉。

defaults.title: PHP script probing
defaults.content: script not found or unable to stat errors indicating direct probing of PHP scripts or upload paths.
defaults.advice: Inspect probed script paths, review Referer and user agent, and block repeated script enumeration attempts.
defaults.advice_cn: 核查被探测脚本路径、Referer 与 User-Agent，并封禁重复脚本枚举来源。

defaults.title: Sensitive resource denial probing
defaults.content: 403, denied-by-configuration, or similar responses while probing restricted directories or files.
defaults.advice: Confirm whether the requested resource should ever be reachable, tighten virtual host rules, and preserve source evidence.
defaults.advice_cn: 确认被探测资源是否本应开放，收紧虚拟主机规则，并保留来源证据用于追踪。

defaults.title: Audit command execution chain
defaults.content: Audit records show chained command execution, shell spawning, or sensitive binary invocation from a privileged context.
defaults.advice: Reconstruct parent-child process chains, identify initial trigger commands, and inspect file or account changes made by the chain.
defaults.advice_cn: 还原父子进程链路，定位最初触发命令，并检查该链路引发的文件或账号变更。

defaults.title: Sensitive account file access in audit logs
defaults.content: Audit logs indicate access to passwd, shadow, sudoers, SSH keys, or related identity artifacts.
defaults.advice: Validate whether the access was expected, review the accessing process and user, and rotate exposed credentials or keys if needed.
defaults.advice_cn: 确认对 passwd、shadow、sudoers 或密钥文件的访问是否符合预期，并视情况轮换暴露凭据或密钥。

defaults.title: Sudo chain anomaly
defaults.content: Sudo-related logs indicate unusual privilege escalation cadence, sensitive commands, or unexpected accounts using sudo.
defaults.advice: Audit sudoers entries, confirm command legitimacy, and review whether the account should hold elevated privileges at that time.
defaults.advice_cn: 审计 sudoers 配置、确认命令合法性，并核查该账号在当前时段是否应具备提权权限。

defaults.title: OpenVPN remote access establishment
defaults.content: OpenVPN peer connection initiated events from unusual peers, networks, or service accounts.
defaults.advice: Verify peer identity, certificate usage, connection time window, and subsequent host activity; revoke suspicious certificates if needed.
defaults.advice_cn: 核查对端身份、证书使用情况、连接时段与后续主机行为，必要时吊销可疑证书。

defaults.title: OpenVPN reconnect churn
defaults.content: Repeated OpenVPN connect-disconnect cycles that may indicate credential abuse, unstable tunneling tools, or probing.
defaults.advice: Correlate reconnect cycles with authentication results, peer IP changes, and tunnel activity; consider temporary source blocking.
defaults.advice_cn: 将重复重连与认证结果、对端 IP 变化和隧道活动关联分析，必要时临时封禁来源。

defaults.title: Apache malformed request spray
defaults.content: A burst of malformed HTTP requests, uncommon verbs, or invalid protocol combinations targeting the same host.
defaults.advice: Inspect request variants, confirm whether they target a known parser weakness, and tune reverse proxy or WAF signatures.
defaults.advice_cn: 检查异常请求变体，确认是否针对已知解析弱点，并优化反向代理或 WAF 规则。

defaults.title: Web error trigger after scanner probe
defaults.content: Web error logs spike shortly after scanning or probing traffic, suggesting the scanner is now hitting executable paths or weak handlers.
defaults.advice: Correlate access and error logs by client and timestamp, identify the first failing endpoint, and validate whether a vulnerable handler exists.
defaults.advice_cn: 按客户端与时间关联访问日志和错误日志，定位最早触发异常的端点，并验证是否存在脆弱处理器。

建议结合上下文进行人工复核。
